expectations.statement: Record difficulty, style and participant_id match the fixture context.
Exactly one difficulty one-hot is set and it is Racer (index 58).
The surge style input sets the Surge one-hot (index 60) and clears Switch (index 61).
Two neighbor slots are present (indices 32, 38) and two absent; absent slots 2 and 3 are fully zeroed and masks.neighbor_slots agrees.
Present neighbors are sorted by ascending absolute route gap (21 m then 35 m ahead).
Racer difficulty uses the 12-tick delayed traffic snapshot.
With history_valid 1, the pass side is -1/0/1, the recent-contact flag is 0/1, and the attempt age and forward distance are non-negative.
Every raw_inputs probe normalizes to the recorded feature value under the schema coefficients (speed/top-speed, lane offset/usable half-width, curvature x100, grade/0.12, gap/70, etc.).
No safe diagnostic fallback is active, so no defaults are required.
Every null that means 'not yet determined' (occupancy_encounter_gap_m) has a matching unknowns entry.

Every raw_inputs key is a canonical feature-index string naming each index at most once, so an aliased key (e.g. '027' for 27) cannot satisfy one check while bypassing another that looks the index up canonically.
Every declared metric is a documented initial target or an explicit undecided requirement; no fixture metric claims a measured status.
Each metric's bound members match its comparator: threshold comparators carry a numeric value, range/ratio_range carry ordered value_min/value_max, report carries no bound.
The optional diagnostic neighbor_ids list carries one stable participant ID per present slot in slot order, and equal absolute gaps appear in ascending stable-ID order.

unknowns.reason: OPPONENT_AI.md evaluates corridor occupancy 'at the planned encounter' but does not fix the encounter distance, so the occupancy fractions cannot be tied to a route gap yet.
Placeholder only: no ObservationBuilder revision is ratified until M4.2 implements the shared interface.

The current-vs-delayed split inside the history group (own lane targets 51,52 and own forward distance 55 treated as current; traffic-derived pass side 53, attempt age 54 and recent contact 56 treated as delayed) is an interpretation of OPPONENT_AI.md and must be confirmed when demonstrations are collected.

The usable-half-width convention is unratified and blocks dependent work: OPPONENT_AI.md normalizes feature 4 (lane offset) by the 'usable half-width' and divides history lane targets 51-52 'by its then-usable half-width' without defining the quantity, while its action-0 decode derives the narrower legal corridor (road_width - car_width)/2 - 0.5 m. The authored value here is road_width/2 (12 m section, 6.0 m half-width) as an illustrative value only The convention (road half-width versus the action-0 legal-corridor half-width) must be ratified before demonstrations are collected; this slice records the ambiguity and does not decide it.
